architecture: One catalog/matrix operation composed from shared sources, join, dimensions and aggregates. No phrase-specific handler and no standalone runtime path.
user_intent: Split realized product quantity and realized buyer unit price by Ozon-reported payment method for any authorized period, day and SKU.

sources.role: positive realization rows, SKU, quantity, buyer line amount, unit_number
posting_number, order_id, product SKU/quantity, analytics_data.payment_type_group_name; cursor pagination
same metadata for FBS; cursor pagination; no result wrapper

join.cardinality: many accrual rows to one posting; validate product quantity and SKU; reject conflicting duplicates; preserve target cohort
join.metadata_period: Cover creation dates of target realization postings, including prior months. Never silently substitute order-date cohort.
join.missing: report explicit unknown/unmatched coverage; do not label unknown as non-card

payment_semantics.unknown: explicit separate group; preserve raw label
forbidden_inference: all other labels => external bank card
difference of group means => counterfactual card discount

acceptance: reconcile complete source pages and target rows
no duplicate posting metadata or target row multiplication
weighted means and additive totals reconcile by day,SKU,payment
same cohort as requested time axis
no price/quantity filtering without user instruction
speech_examples_proposed_not_installed: Сколько товаров реализовано с оплатой Ozon Банком и другими способами за октябрь 2026?
Покажи по дням и всем товарам количество и среднюю цену реализации в разрезе способов оплаты за выбранный месяц.
llm_role: bounded semantic plan only; no financial arithmetic or invented payment labels
limitations: does not expose alternative no-card price for an identical past order
no causal effect, discount rate or optimal price inferred from payment mix
returns unsupported in this positive realization qualification
all runtime allowlists,quotas,access checks,cache lineage and matrix registration still required
